entities.summary: Craig Michael Conroy is an American former professional ice hockey player and current executive. He currently serves as the current general manager of the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL), for whom he also played. A sixth-round selection of the Montreal Canadiens at the 1990 NHL entry draft, Conroy played 1,009 NHL games for the Canadiens, St. Louis Blues, Flames and Los Angeles Kings during a professional career that spanned from 1994 to 2011. Internationally, he twice played with the United States National Team – at the 2004 World Cup of Hockey and the 2006 Winter Olympics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a six-time Stanley Cup champion and two-time Olympic gold medalist, Craig Conroy's professional hockey career spanned over 17 years, earning him a place among the NHL's all-time leaders in games played by a defenseman. His on-ice accomplishments have had a lasting impact on the sport in North America.
